@Nadia Fennimore: Gideon's final number for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update was **280 seats**.

He first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1. Ruth also asked him to update the Q3 QBR deck to the corrected number.
